description: This file manages reading, parsing, and handling Matrix credentials, including resolving credential paths, loading credentials from files, migrating legacy credentials, and matching credentials with configuration.

classes.name: MatrixStoredCredentials
classes.description: Type representing stored Matrix credentials including homeserver, userId, accessToken, deviceId, creation and last used timestamps.

methods.name: resolveStateDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory for storing state, considering environment variables and fallback options.

methods.name: resolveLegacyMatrixCredentialsPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to legacy credentials JSON file.

methods.name: shouldReadLegacyCredentialsForAccount
methods.description: Determines if legacy credentials should be read for a given account ID based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveLegacyMigrationSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to legacy credentials if migration is needed.

methods.name: parseMatrixCredentialsFile
methods.description: Parses a credentials JSON file into a MatrixStoredCredentials object.

methods.name: loadMatrixCredentialsFile
methods.description: Loads credentials from a file, returning a result indicating success or missing file.

methods.name: loadLegacyMatrixCredentialsWithCurrentFallback
methods.description: Attempts to load legacy credentials, falling back to current credentials if necessary.

methods.name: resolveMatrixCredentialsDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory for Matrix credentials, considering environment and optional state directory.

methods.name: resolveMatrixCredentialsPath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the credentials file for a given account.

methods.name: loadMatrixCredentials
methods.description: Loads Matrix credentials for a given environment and account, handling legacy migration.

methods.name: clearMatrixCredentials
methods.description: Deletes stored credentials files for a given environment and account.

methods.name: credentialsMatchConfig
methods.description: Checks if stored credentials match a given configuration.
